status: Exploratory extension motivated by unstable extrapolation in the third round; not an untouched confirmatory study
question: Do the already selected weather-anomaly transfer rules become usable when source scores must lie inside the recent target calibration score range?
models_and_rules: Reuse all 72 frozen third-round configurations; no model refitting or reselection
additional_condition: For every prediction month, require minimum <= source score <= maximum of that model's scores on the same strictly earlier sentinel rows used for calibration
threshold_origin: Rolling calibration predictors only; no current target outcomes and no validation-dependent quantile tuning
gate_complexity: Original mandatory weather-quality requirements, at most two original learned inequalities, plus two dynamic score-range bounds
comparators: Both the previously frozen local comparator and the arithmetic local mean fitted on the identical past-only labels
success: At least 5 percent lower RMSE than both comparators, at least 25 percent of all rows and all FUAs, at least 5 FUAs and 12 months, positive paired cluster-bootstrap lower bounds against both comparators in temporal confirmation and other-city audit; discovery improvement must hold in both discovery years
inference: Report failures and retained coverage; do not claim causality, a globally minimal condition, or rigorous post-selection coverage
